blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — The validity of the new House Rules came under renewed scrutiny on Tuesday after a councilor questioned whether the legislative body properly approved the measure during its July 7 session. This prompted members to seek further examination of the official minutes by the Department of the Interior and Local Government (DILG). Councilor Sisinio Andales, the minority floor leader, questioned the adoption process during the council’s deliberations.
